releaseNotes:
- Agent now keeps real recovery evidence and continues useful work after recoverable failures instead of handing ordinary decisions back to the user.
- Image production avoids duplicate paid submissions while allowing independent assets to use shared capacity concurrently.
- Image review model selection now follows the live gateway catalog and defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol when available.
- Interrupted uploads and project transfers recover through the configured proxy without replaying paid production tasks.
- Unused assets stay cleared, cover receipts remain scoped, and retryable voice and editing conflicts preserve actionable details.
releaseNotesZh:
- Agent 现会保留真实恢复证据，并在可恢复失败后继续推进，不再把普通判断反复交还给用户。
- 图片生产现可避免重复付费提交，同时允许彼此独立的素材共享容量并发执行。
- 图片审核模型现会跟随实时网关目录，并在可用时默认使用 GPT-5.6 Sol。
- 上传与项目传输中断后可通过既有代理恢复，并避免重复执行付费生产任务。
- 未使用素材会保持清理状态，封面回执范围更准确，配音重试与编辑冲突也会保留可操作详情。
